corrections.correction: The authoritative report is actual [[0], [None]] versus expected [[0]]. [None] is an extra second group containing a separator, not a third group or an empty list.
A passing bounded control supports the comparison but cannot alone rule out every domain or generator problem. The separate contract and independent-oracle review provides the additional evidence.

modelSummaryReview.note: These corrections concern the final natural-language summary, not the recorded commands, exit codes or original reports. No reasoning blocks are copied.

limitations: The model reran prepared specifications; discovery, contract review, independent API checks and novelty classification are separate evidence in each case study.
A counterexample is evidence against the stated property, not automatic maintainer confirmation or a new vulnerability claim.
No-counterexample controls are bounded searches, not proofs; evaluations include generation and shrinking and are not unique-input counts.
Recorded workspace-write policy and absence of requested escalation do not independently prove every operating-system sandbox boundary.
Package source hashes were resolved with the same interpreters after execution and compared to prior provenance; driver before/after immutability covers the eight case files only.
Exact commands are compared before portable path substitution; raw run records and trace hashes identify the retained originals.
No model reasoning, full request bodies, credentials or personal absolute paths are included in this public summary.
